title: async / await

choices.md: Only the async function you are in

blocks.explainMd: Only the async function waits. Other work on the page can still run.

blocks.promptMd: > `async function label()` must `await` a real promise (e.g. `Promise.resolve()`), then return `"keyed"`. Do not just `return "keyed"`. Print it.

hintLadder.md: `label` must be `async` so you can `await` inside it.
Await a resolved promise, then return the word `keyed`.
Print the returned value from `then`, and export `label`.

description: Await pauses this function until a promise settles, then continues.
